# مُجتمعي (mogtama3y.com)

> A free Arabic neighbourhood app for Egypt and the Arab world: a directory of nearby shops and services, free online stores for shop owners, owners' unions for residential buildings, and mosque pages. The app is a Flutter web app (its screens render client-side); the crawlable content is in the static guide pages and the directory site below.

## Apps
- [مُجتمعي](https://mogtama3y.com/): the main app (directory, stores, classifieds, neighbourhood)
- [متجري](https://tajer.mogtama3y.com/): a free online store for a shop, with no commission
- [اتحاد الملاك](https://ittihad.mogtama3y.com/): building owners' unions: dues, expenses, announcements
- [مسجدي](https://masjidi.mogtama3y.com/): a page for a mosque: prayer times, iqama, Friday sermon

## Crawlable content
- [دليل مُجتمعي](https://dalil.mogtama3y.com/): places, stores, products and prices, described in [its llms.txt](https://dalil.mogtama3y.com/llms.txt)
- [Sitemap](https://mogtama3y.com/sitemap.xml)
